label.zh: 按是否知晓巴奥人二选一

note.zh: 3000 的两个“联络行星的栖息地”选项文字相同，按探索帝国是否已开始或完成巴奥事件链只出现其一。
note.en: Event 3000 has two identical “Contact the planet's inhabitants.” options; only one appears, depending on whether the explorer has started or completed the Baol event chain.

label.zh: 按是否知晓巴奥人二选一

note.zh: 3055 的两个选项分别要求已知/未知巴奥事件链，玩家只会看到其中一个。
note.en: The two options of 3055 require the Baol event chain to be known / unknown; the player sees only one of them.

label.zh: 按是否知晓巴奥人二选一

note.zh: 3025 的同名选项按巴奥事件链状态分别通向 3045 或 3046，两者都在约 720–1440 天后接 3047。
note.en: The same-named option of 3025 leads to 3045 or 3046 by Baol event chain status; both lead to 3047 about 720–1440 days later.

label.zh: 基因强化：可招募橡树茎

note.zh: 裂隙探索结束，获得大量星界丝缕；巴奥指挥官“橡树茎”可以招募或遣散。
note.en: The rift exploration ends with a large astral thread reward; the Baol commander Oakenstalk can be enlisted or dismissed.

astral_rift.3031.evidence: events/astral_rifts_3_events.txt:585-592 (3030 option: astral_thread_large_reward, country_event 3031, finish_astral_rift); 3031 creates a renowned commander 606-679

label.zh: 行星隐形：解锁星界隐形法令

note.zh: 花费 50 星界丝缕选择此路；探索结束并解锁“星界隐形”法令。
note.en: Chosen for 50 astral threads; the exploration ends and the Astral Cloaking edict becomes available.

astral_rift.3035.evidence: events/astral_rifts_3_events.txt:347-367 (3020.b requires tech_cloaking_1, costs 50 threads); 692-702 (3035 sets astral_cloaking_available, finish_astral_rift)

note.zh: 探索结束；在离裂隙最近的己方殖民地生成一批巴奥人口（格式塔帝国生成蜂巢版巴奥）。
note.en: The exploration ends; a Baol pop group appears on the empire's colony nearest the rift (a hive-minded Baol species for gestalt empires).

note.zh: 花费 100 星界丝缕选择此路；探索结束，获得“星界护盾实验”修正。
note.en: Chosen for 100 astral threads; the exploration ends with the Astral Shield Experimentation modifier.

note.zh: 3045/3046 结束探索并留下社会研究矿藏；约 720–1440 天后本篇发生，矿藏移除并给予研究产出。
note.en: 3045/3046 end the exploration and leave a society research deposit; this event follows about 720–1440 days later, removing the deposit and granting research.

label.zh: 交换科技：古茹努尔武器界面

note.zh: 探索结束，获得“古茹努尔武器界面”修正与大量星界丝缕。
note.en: The exploration ends with the Grunur Weapons Interface modifier and a large astral thread reward.

note.zh: 探索结束；可建造焰爆部队，并获得一项军事理论研究选项。
note.en: The exploration ends; Flamestorm Troopers can be built and a military theory research option is granted.

note.zh: 3095 中科学家被古茹努尔扣押、探索结束；约 1800–2520 天后科学家带着新特质（含“裂隙扭曲”）归来。
note.en: In 3095 the scientist is detained by the Grunur and the exploration ends; about 1800–2520 days later the scientist returns with new traits, including Rift Warped.

notes.zh: 此裂隙从探索帝国的裂隙池中按权重抽取：基础 1；正在进行巴奥事件链 ×2，已完成 ×4。
notes.en: This rift is drawn from the explorer's rift pool by weight: base 1, ×2 while the Baol event chain is running, ×4 once it is completed.

notes.zh: 实际只出现一个“分享某科技”选项：3055.a 按固定顺序检查帝国已拥有的科技，只标记第一项。十九个科技选项都通向 3070，地图上的多条连线是同一选择的不同版本。
notes.en: Only one “Share <technology>” option actually appears: 3055.a checks the empire's technologies in a fixed order and flags only the first one it has. All nineteen technology options lead to 3070; the parallel map links are versions of one choice.

scope.zh: 已逐段核对裂隙定义、3000–3099 全部事件的选项、条件、终止与延时后续，并对照中英文标题与选项。
scope.en: Checked the rift definition and every event 3000–3099: options, conditions, finishes and delayed follow-ups, against both localisations.

uncertain: Text variants keyed by has_astral_rift_flag description_* (set by astral_planes.6 from the explorer's identity) are not resolved by the V4 condition model; see ledger Requests.

note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

note.en: In the game, a body part of the leader's species appears here.
